series: 재난 유형별 피해 양상과 대응 방안

style_prefix.3d_real: Photorealistic cinematic aerial footage of real Korean terrain and buildings at true scale, shot on a high-end drone camera, natural light and realistic materials, documentary realism. Subtle thin glowing blue engineering wireframe lines outline ONLY the buildings like an architectural technical visualization; there are no lines at all on the terrain, trees, water, roads, sky or people, and people look completely natural. Not a miniature, not a toy model, not cartoon, single continuous shot, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, every sign, signboard, banner, screen and license plate is completely blank with no writing.

cutaway_text: Part of the ground is cut away as a clean vertical cross-section revealing the real soil and rock layers underneath, to show what happens below the surface.
